situations.title: DKA 초기 사정
situations.tagline: I've been throwing up all day and I just feel so dried out and out of it.
situations.brief: DKA 환자의 탈수와 산증, 의식 상태를 초기에 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm going to check your hydration, your breathing, and how alert you feel.
Have you been able to keep any fluids down today?
Your fast breathing can be your body reacting to acid, so I'm watching it closely.
goals: 탈수와 Kussmaul 호흡, 의식 저하를 체계적으로 확인한다

situations.title: 혈당·케톤·ABG 모니터
situations.tagline: Why do you keep pricking my finger and drawing my blood over and over?
situations.brief: 혈당과 케톤, ABG 지표를 주기적으로 추적하며 추세를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: We check your sugar, your ketones, and your blood acid every hour to keep you safe.
These numbers tell us how your treatment is working.
I'll let you know as soon as your levels start moving the right way.
goals: 지표 추세를 환자에게 이해하기 쉽게 설명한다

situations.title: 수액 소생 시작
situations.tagline: That bag is running in so fast — is all that fluid really okay for me?
situations.brief: 탈수 교정을 위해 수액 소생을 시작하고 목적을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: You lost a lot of fluid, so we're replacing it quickly at first.
I'll keep watching your blood pressure and urine as the fluids go in.
Tell me if you feel any tightness in your chest or trouble breathing.

situations.title: 인슐린 주입 준비
situations.tagline: Could you walk me through how you're setting up this insulin drip before you start it?
situations.brief: 프로토콜에 따라 인슐린 주입 라인을 안전하게 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm priming a dedicated line for the insulin drip per protocol.
Let's double-check the concentration and pump settings together.
I'll start the infusion once potassium is confirmed safe.

situations.title: 인슐린 전 K 확인
situations.tagline: His potassium result just came back — do you want to look before we start insulin?
situations.brief: 인슐린 투여 전 저K 예방을 위해 칼륨을 반드시 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: We hold insulin until potassium is safe, so let's confirm the level first.
Insulin drives potassium into cells, so a low value could be dangerous.
If it's low, we'll replace potassium before starting the drip.
goals: 인슐린 시작 전 칼륨 수치를 반드시 확인한다

situations.title: 활력·의식 재평가
situations.tagline: I think I'm a little more with it now — my head doesn't feel as foggy.
situations.brief: 치료 후 활력징후와 의식 반응의 변화를 재평가하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm glad you feel clearer, and I'll recheck your vitals to confirm.
Can you tell me your name and where you are for me?
Your numbers are heading the right direction, which is a good sign.

situations.title: DKA 인슐린 주입 적정
situations.tagline: My sugar dropped a lot already — are you going to turn the insulin down now?
situations.brief: 혈당 하강 속도를 보며 인슐린 주입을 안전하게 적정하세요.
keyPhrases: We adjust the insulin so your sugar comes down at a safe pace.
Bringing it down too fast can be risky, so we titrate carefully.
I'll recheck your glucose and set the new rate per protocol.
goals: 혈당 하강 속도를 목표 범위로 유지한다

situations.title: K 보정·인슐린 균형
situations.tagline: His potassium is trending down again while the insulin's running — how do you want to handle it?
situations.brief: 인슐린 투여 중 저K를 예방하도록 칼륨 보정과 균형을 맞추세요.
keyPhrases: Let's replace potassium and keep monitoring it closely with the insulin running.
We may need to slow the insulin if potassium keeps falling.
I'll draw a repeat level after the replacement to confirm.
goals: 인슐린 중 칼륨을 목표 범위로 보정한다

situations.title: anion gap 종결 판단
situations.tagline: His anion gap has closed and the bicarb looks better — is he ready to transition?
situations.brief: anion gap 정상화를 확인하고 인슐린 전환 시점을 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: The gap has closed, so we can plan the switch to subcutaneous insulin.
We overlap the drip with the first long-acting dose before stopping.
Let me confirm he's eating and the labs are stable first.
goals: anion gap 종결과 산증 회복을 확인한다
주입 종료와 피하 전환 시점을 판단한다

situations.title: HHS 고삼투 관리
situations.tagline: My mother's been so confused and terribly thirsty for days — what's happening to her?
situations.brief: HHS의 고삼투 상태를 서서히 교정하며 안전하게 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Her sugar and blood are very concentrated, so we're correcting it slowly and safely.
Going too fast could affect her brain, so we take our time.
We'll watch her mental status closely as she improves.
goals: 교정 중 신경학적 변화를 관찰하고 보고한다

situations.title: 저혈당 예방·포도당 병용
situations.tagline: His sugar's coming down nicely — should we start the dextrose now?
situations.brief: 전환기에 저혈당을 예방하도록 포도당을 병용하며 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Once his sugar reaches the threshold, we add dextrose while continuing insulin.
This lets us keep clearing the ketones without dropping too low.
I'll recheck the glucose and adjust both drips together.
goals: 임계 혈당에서 포도당을 병용해 저혈당을 예방한다

situations.title: 유발원인 동반 치료
situations.tagline: So what set all this off — was it an infection that put him in here?
situations.brief: 감염 등 촉발인자를 함께 파악하고 동반 치료를 연계하세요.
keyPhrases: We're looking for a trigger like an infection and treating it alongside the DKA.
Fixing the cause helps prevent this from coming back.
We've started cultures and will adjust treatment based on the results.
goals: 유발원인 치료를 DKA 관리와 함께 연계한다

situations.title: 부신위기 스테로이드 투여
situations.tagline: He crashed so suddenly — why does he need this steroid shot right now?
situations.brief: 부신위기에서 스트레스 용량 스테로이드를 신속히 투여하고 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: His body can't make enough stress hormone, so we're giving it now.
This steroid can quickly stabilize his blood pressure.
We'll keep monitoring and give more if his stress level demands it.
goals: 부신위기를 인지하고 스트레스 용량 스테로이드를 투여한다

situations.title: 갑상선기능저하 점액수종 관리
situations.tagline: She's so cold to the touch and her heart rate is really slow — is she going to be okay?
situations.brief: 저체온과 서맥을 동반한 점액수종 환자를 안정적으로 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Her thyroid is very low, which slows her heart and drops her temperature.
We're warming her gently and giving thyroid hormone.
We'll monitor her heart rate and temperature very closely.

situations.title: 교정속도 뇌부종 위험 인지
situations.tagline: You keep saying slow and steady — why can't you just fix his numbers faster?
situations.brief: 급성 교정 시 뇌부종 위험을 인지하고 교정 속도를 조절하세요.
keyPhrases: Correcting too quickly can cause dangerous brain swelling.
A slow, steady pace is actually the safest way to help him.
We're watching his neuro status while we correct carefully.
goals: 급속 교정에 따른 뇌부종 위험을 인지한다

situations.title: DKA 뇌부종 급변 위기
situations.tagline: He was talking a minute ago and now he's barely responding — please, something's wrong!
situations.brief: DKA 중 신경학적 급변을 뇌부종으로 인지하고 즉시 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: This sudden change is serious and I'm calling the team right now.
I'm raising the head of the bed and rechecking his neuro status.
We're acting immediately to protect his brain.
goals: 응급 중재를 시작하고 팀을 신속히 소집한다

situations.title: 갑상선폭풍 위기
situations.tagline: She's burning up and her heart is pounding out of control — what is going on?
situations.brief: 고열과 빈맥, 다약제 요법이 필요한 갑상선폭풍을 위기로 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Her thyroid is dangerously overactive, causing this fever and racing heart.
We're giving several medicines together to bring it under control.
We're cooling her and watching her heart continuously.

situations.title: 부신위기 순환붕괴
situations.tagline: Her pressure just bottomed out — the steroids aren't working, are they?
situations.brief: 부신위기 순환붕괴에서 스테로이드와 승압제를 함께 사용해 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's push the stress-dose steroid and start a pressor together now.
I'm giving a fluid bolus while we titrate the vasopressor.
Call the intensivist — this is a true adrenal crisis.

situations.title: 심한 저혈당 의식소실 위기
situations.tagline: He was drowsy and now he won't wake up at all — his sugar must be too low!
situations.brief: 심한 저혈당으로 의식을 잃은 환자에게 응급 포도당을 투여하세요.
keyPhrases: Check a stat glucose and push D50 now — he's unresponsive.
I'm protecting his airway while the dextrose goes in.
Recheck the sugar in a few minutes and stay ready to repeat.
goals: 심한 저혈당에 의한 의식소실을 즉시 인지한다

situations.title: 점액수종 혼수 위기
situations.tagline: She won't respond and she feels ice cold — is she slipping into a coma?
situations.brief: 점액수종 혼수 위기에서 갑상선호르몬과 지지치료를 즉시 시작하세요.
keyPhrases: Her thyroid failure has become critical, and we're treating it urgently.
We're giving thyroid hormone and warming and supporting her body.
We're watching her breathing and heart very closely.

situations.title: 내분비 위기 다장기 악화
situations.tagline: Everything seems to be failing at once — I need someone to tell me the real picture.
situations.brief: 내분비 위기의 다장기 악화를 에스컬레이션하고 명확히 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: Several of his organs are under stress, and the whole team is involved.
I'll give you a clear update as each specialist weighs in.
We're escalating his care and staying right at his bedside.
